title: Room (data/rooms/<id>.json)
description: One room. Rules JSON Schema cannot express (width + depth <= 32, bounds, overlaps, known types) are checked by src/data/validate.js.

size.description: [width x, height y, depth z] in blocks; width + depth <= 32.

spawn.description: Player start (feet center) when the game starts in this room.

reset.description: Where the wizard reappears (feet center) after dying in this room, however he entered it. Defaults to "spawn" if omitted. Above the floor is fine: he falls from there like anywhere else.

blocks.description: Anonymous static blocks: plain (room color), hazard (hurts on touch) or void (kills on landing).

holes.description: Floor tiles that are pits: deadly for the player; a pushed block drops in and fills the hole.

objects.description: Typed objects with stable ids (types from defs.json).

exit.description: Opening in one side of the room. Connections live in world.json.

at.description: First cell along the side (z for x sides, x for z sides).

type.description: block: plain; hazard: hurts the wizard on touch; void: kills him when he lands on it. Looks are in defs.json "blocks".

to.description: Optional opposite corner; fills the box from at to to (inclusive).
Optional opposite corner; fills the rectangle from at to to (inclusive).

overrides.description: Values that replace the type defaults for this object only.

path.description: Required for platforms (and only allowed on them): the path they follow, starting at "at".
Path shared by moving platforms (and later patrolling enemies): from the object's "at" through "points", each leg along one axis.

points.description: Waypoints after "at" (the object's lower corner); each differs from the one before on exactly one axis.

mode.description: pingpong: there and back; loop: from the last point straight back to "at" (also along one axis).

pause.description: Seconds of waiting at the ends: both ends of a ping-pong path, "at" on a loop.
